description: This file defines a PHP class for plotting a fitted line (using linear regression) on a graph, including methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the plot with regression calculations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Fit_Line
classes.description: A class that extends Image_Graph_Plot to perform linear regression fitting and plotting of a line on a graph.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample line in the legend to represent the fitted line.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the plotting of the regression line on the graph, including calculating the regression and drawing the line.
